settings.repere: Texte · Is this a testosterone booster?
settings.text: Is this a testosterone booster?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It's not a synthetic booster. But shilaj
settings.text: It's not a synthetic booster. But shilajit itself has been tested on men for testosterone. In a 90-day, randomized, placebo-controlled trial, healthy men aged 45 to 55 took purified shilajit, 250 mg twice a day. Total testosterone, free testosterone and DHEAS all ended significantly higher than in the men on placebo (P < 0.05; PMID 26395129).* A pea-sized scoop is a different amount from the study dose, so we make no promise. You get 90 days to find out.

settings.text: Put a bead in the freezer: real resin goes hard and snaps clean. Warm it in your palm: it softens. Drop it in warm water: it dissolves fully, no grit. A powder or a pill gives you nothing to check.
